finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers should note the free tier is capped at 5 signature requests per month.

quote.text: if you are not satisfied using the product and the product does not work as it is described, you can return the product within 10 business days from the date of purchase.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 500 signature requests per month

Stack up to 3 codes
- 500 signature requests per month
- 1 team member (primary account holder)

trials.reasoning: A buyer reports getting only 5 signature requests per month, directly conflicting with the promised 500 per month, despite another review mentioning 500.

exhibits.quote: I signed up thinking I paid for unlimited envelopes and I only get 5 per month.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports receiving only 5 per month instead of the promised high volume, undermining the 500-request claim.

exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms the first tier includes 500 signatures on a monthly basis.

exhibits.quote: 1. Single user at this tier, that seems really light.
exhibits.argument: The buyer confirms Plan 1 is limited to a single user.
